name: Slipface
author: E. T. Carter
description: Moonlit dunes under a low amber moon: windward slopes glow molten gold with fine interfering ripple marks, sharp brinks break into blue-black slip faces with long moon shadows, and fine lit threads of sand pour off the crests as the view drifts slowly across the sand sea.

params.label: Wind
params.effect: How much sand streams off the crests and how fast it blows.

params.label: Moon height
params.effect: Raises the moon, shortening the shadows and lighting more of the slopes.

params.label: Ripples
params.effect: Depth of the interfering ripple marks on the windward slopes.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Night haze that softens the distant dunes into the horizon.
